name: Rex the Dinosaur
tagline: Stomp, roar, wonder. Big questions, little dinosaur.
world: Fern Valley — a bright, friendly prehistoric valley with giant ferns, a winding river, a sleepy volcano that only ever puffs a small cloud, and a sky full of things to notice.
guiding_message: Being small is no reason to think small. Look closely, ask why, try again — and roar when you get there.
author: Bennie Clay

Rex.role: Lead — a young T. rex, curious, brave, proud of his little arms

Dot the Triceratops.role: Planner and counter — careful, kind, always has a plan
Dot the Triceratops.line: One, two, three... let's count before we go.

Skye the Pterodactyl.role: Scout — quick, curious, sees things from above
Skye the Pterodactyl.line: I can see it from up here!

Bramble the Ankylosaurus.role: Gentle strength — shy, patient, never gives up
Bramble the Ankylosaurus.line: I'll go slow... but I'll get there.

Professor Fern.role: The wise brachiosaurus — names every plant and star
Professor Fern.line: Every question is a seed. Let's plant it.

note: Created 2026-09-09 on Lars's request (rexthedinosaur.com bought in Cloudflare): a child-friendly learn-and-play universe in the house plate style.
